runtime_requirements.connection: Import config in each script as it contains connection parameters. Never hardcode paths.
runtime_requirements.duckdb_path: Connect using duckdb.connect(os.environ['DUCKDB_PATH']). DUCKDB_PATH is already set in env.
runtime_requirements.source_data_dir: Read all source files from context['source_files']
runtime_requirements.idempotency: All scripts must be safely re-runnable.
runtime_requirements.error_handling: Capture and log errors with stage classification. Always close connection in finally block.

operational_requirements.logging: Emit structured JSON log lines for every lifecycle stage.
operational_requirements.observability: Include row-count assertions and stage markers legible to downstream monitoring.
